prose: Leo season herbs and the plants that represent the lion and the heart's light. Kyle Denton (Tippecanoe Herbs), Mario Garza (Symbolic Studies), Michelle Lundquist, and Slick Dissident joined Chance Garton for the Leo installment of Astro Herbalism, covering St John's Wort, Motherwort, Angelica, Sunflower, Hawthorn and Lion's Tail through the doctrine of signatures.

In this remastered episode (originally from 2023), audio has been improved and unnecessary tangents removed, turning a rough livestream into a concise master-class on Leo in the Zodiac, the Strength card in Tarot, the Heart, healthy boundaries, and the plants that exemplify all these archetypal energies.
